announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.9.1 — Gemini kini punya pilihan model (Flash-Lite / Flash / Pro). ARA otomatis memilih Pro + tingkat Rendah sebelum tiap kiriman — dari uji nyata paling setia pada desain; bila jatah Pro habis, ARA memakai Flash, dan memberi tahu bila Gemini terpaksa turun ke Flash-Lite. Termasuk semua isi 4.9.0: Tur Virtual 360, Video Putar 360, mesin ChatGPT (pilihan), pindah akun Gemini. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.9.1 — Gemini now has a model picker (Flash-Lite / Flash / Pro). ARA automatically picks Pro + Low thinking before every send — the most faithful to your design in real tests; if Pro quota runs out it uses Flash, and it tells you when Gemini falls back to Flash-Lite. Includes everything from 4.9.0: 360 Virtual Tour, 360 Spin Video, optional ChatGPT engine, Gemini account switching. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
